English menu; kids' menu; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi; take-away. Cash only per Tabelog (no cards, no e-money). On Ayanokoji west of Fuyacho, 2 min from Kawaramachi exit 11. Opened 15 July 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_raicha_spice_cafe_ayanokoji.notes: [Nepalese curry · Ayanokoji near Kawaramachi, giant naan and a dog-friendly terrace] A bright Nepalese-run curry café a block from Kawaramachi: good-value lunch sets with chicken tikka, naan bigger than your plate from the tandoor, cheese naan, biryani and a vegetable curry, with five spice levels. Friendly staff are the most-praised thing here; some find the curries mild. Dogs welcome on the terrace. Cash only. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 July 2020 (Tabelog), with curry "made by a chef from Nepal" per its Tabelog highlights. Retty, Uber Eats and a Kyoto curry guide list it in Latin as "raicha Spice Cafe Restaurant"; Tabelog's English page renders the name "Righteous". Reviewers from 2021 to 2026 praise a Nepalese manager "fluent in Japanese" (May 2024), cheerful staff and tandoor-baked naan; a few found the curries milder than hoped (November 2022; September 2023).

anecdotes.text: June 2023: "I was blown away by the size of the naan that came out of the tandoor right in front of me! It's huge! … And apparently, you can take home any leftovers."
September 2023: "I chose the butter chicken curry, but it wasn't quite what I expected; it was quite mild."
April 2025: "I visited this place at the end of my trip to Kyoto with my dog. The terrace seating is dog-friendly, so we enjoyed our meal outside."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ライチャスパイスカフェレストラン、ネパール料理・インドカレー・カフェ、下京区綾小路通麩屋町西入塩屋町72 グランシャトレー 1F、河原町駅11番出口から徒歩2分、火〜日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:45)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:45)、月曜休み、予約不可、32席 (カウンター8、テーブル16、テラス8)、テラスのみ喫煙可、テラスはペット可、英語メニュー、キッズメニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー不可、2020年7月15日オープン、ネパール出身のシェフのスパイスカレー、辛さは5段階、炭火で焼くナンとチキンティッカのセット。他の掲載 (Retty、Uber Eats): raicha Spice Cafe Restaurant。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年10月、英語): ランチセット900円 (税抜)、ビールに変更300円、大きなナンは持ち帰り可、チーズナン、タンドリーチキン、ほうれん草チキンカレー、野菜カレー、マトンのビリヤニ、あんこチーズナン、ネパールのビール、日本語が上手なネパール人の店長、明るいスタッフ、カレーがマイルドすぎるとの声 (2022年、2023年)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; pets on the terrace; cash only.

kyoto_isshin_motsunabe_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy-sauce and miso motsu-nabe broths, sukiyaki sauce, udon and champon noodles to finish, kushikatsu and tempura (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_isshin_motsunabe_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef offal hotpot, Wagyu sukiyaki and horse sashimi (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_isshin_motsunabe_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closing days not fixed. Reservations taken. Table charge ¥330 a person — Tabelog, Japanese original 「テーブルチャージ330円/人」. A January 2026 reviewer reports prices 20% higher over the New Year holiday. 80 seats: 18 at the counter and 62 at tables, including a tatami area; private rooms for 10–20. Smoking allowed. QR-code ordering (January 2025). Cards and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay); no e-money. 2nd floor of 木屋町会館, west side of Kiyamachi one street below Takoyakushi. Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog). Some listings give the name as もつ鍋・地鶏工房 いっしん at the same address and phone number.
kyoto_isshin_motsunabe_kiyamachi.notes: [Motsu-nabe and sukiyaki · Kiyamachi, a busy second-floor hotpot izakaya] A big second-floor izakaya above Kiyamachi for beef-offal hotpot — soy-sauce or miso, with no off-smell, reviewers stress — Wagyu sukiyaki and Kumamoto horse sashimi, with udon or champon to finish. Busy, with smoking allowed; service can lag at peak times, and the music is loud for some. ¥330 table charge. Open nightly to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog). No source names the operator or says whether it has sister shops; other listings show it at the same address under the name もつ鍋・地鶏工房 いっしん. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 praise offal "without any unpleasant odor" (November 2024), a broth that is "not overly salty or heavy" (February 2025) and bright, quick staff (January 2025); criticism covers slow service in the year-end rush (December 2024), sukiyaki that was "somewhat average" (April 2025) and loud background music (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "I believe there were about 8 pieces of motsu even for two people, which was a perfect amount considering my age and a sensitive stomach."
October 2025: "I was shocked that I could eat the liver without any unpleasant smell" — of the horse sashimi.
February 2026: "I had sukiyaki, but it wasn't the grilled type, which surprised me a bit… However, the loud background music was a downside."

kyoto_aji_roman_ishigamatei.gf_detail: Ask. Duck shabu-shabu in a white broth, but tempura, ramen to finish and soy seasonings are part of the meals (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aji_roman_ishigamatei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto-duck restaurant; hamo and eel dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aji_roman_ishigamatei.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (food last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, last entry 20:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). On Nishi-Ishigaki south of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_aji_roman_ishigamatei.notes: [Kyoto duck · Kamo riverside] A Kyoto-duck restaurant in a renovated townhouse on the Kamo River, now with riverside tables: duck shabu-shabu in a white broth finished with ramen, roast duck, hamo in season, and a ¥2,200 lunch gozen. Courses about ¥6,000–8,000. ¥660 charge without a course.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 2000 with Kyoto duck and hamo; new ownership from 2018, keeping Kyoto-duck kaiseki (job listing, careermap.jp). A long-time regular noted in August 2026 that the restaurant had moved to its present riverside site.

anecdotes.text: A long-time regular's first visit since the move, in August 2026, was a course of duck shabu-shabu finished with ramen.
Arriving at opening on a September 2026 holiday, a returning diner found about six groups waiting and ordered the ¥2,200 gozen again.
A September 2026 diner who booked 17:30 got a riverside seat for an autumn course, but found the finishing rice porridge one dish too many.

cultural_comfort.note: Courses ordered per table; riverside seats by booking.

kyoto_kyoryori_takara_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with sashimi and soups, but soy-seasoned sukiyaki and nabe appear (reviews).
kyoto_kyoryori_takara_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses, suppon (soft-shell turtle) nabe and sukiyaki (reviews).
kyoto_kyoryori_takara_pontocho.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:30 (last entry 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 50 seats with tatami rooms overlooking the Kamo River, a kawadoko deck in season and a tatami hall for about 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2024 review). On Pontocho just north of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoryori_takara_pontocho.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, Kamo River] A Pontocho kaiseki house of more than 120 years, now with its fourth-generation owner: tatami rooms over the Kamo River and a kawadoko deck in season, seasonal Kyoto courses, suppon hot pot and a riverside sukiyaki. About ¥10,000–15,000 at night. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A traditional Kyoto-cuisine restaurant of more than 120 years, run by the fourth generation (Tabelog shop text). Hitosara describes it as a long-established ryotei whose specialty is suppon (soft-shell turtle), with kawadoko dining on the Kamo River.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal kaiseki of fine ingredients, with the river view (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner had the limited-time sukiyaki overlooking the river and found it worth the price, ordering more rice.
A November 2025 diner praised the view, the attentive staff and dishes that came promptly.
A regular, back again in May 2026, had described an autumn 2024 meal in a tatami hall for about twenty over the river.

kyoto_amanogawa_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu, yuba, tofu and Kyoto vegetables feature, but dashi and fish dishes are likely; not described (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_amanogawa_pontocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–14:30 and 16:00–23:30; open year-round (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Tabelog remarks (English) give a ¥500 appetizer fee. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Staff invite passers-by in from the street (2021–24 reviews). On Pontocho just north of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_amanogawa_pontocho.notes: [Obanzai & nama-fu · Pontocho] An easy-going Pontocho restaurant open from late afternoon (and lunch at weekends) with obanzai and Kyoto courses from ¥2,980 using nama-fu and yuba from 半兵衛麸, plus hot pots and drink plans. Reviews are mixed on value. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text says it uses fresh nama-fu and nama-yuba from the long-established maker 半兵衛麸. An older group website (kyo-sakusaku.com) no longer resolves. Reviews are mixed: several from 2021–23 found portions small or prices high for Pontocho; 2024–25 reviewers found it good value and friendly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Obanzai and Kyoto kaiseki at reasonable prices (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: Arriving after most nearby places had closed for lunch in May 2025, a diner liked the retro room, friendly staff and well-chilled draft beer.
A January 2025 diner dropping in for a drink found the food decent but unremarkable.
A May 2024 holiday visitor before 16:00 found the room busy with late lunches and early dinners, and tofu shumai on a wide menu.

kyoto_teppan_dining_kyoshikian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak courses with abalone (2024–26 reviews).

kyoto_teppan_dining_kyoshikian.notes: [Teppanyaki · Pontocho basement] A relaxed basement teppanyaki on Pontocho: wagyu steak courses around ¥4,800 with yuba (even topped with caviar), abalone and Kyoto vegetables, and garlic rice to finish, with drink plans. About ¥5,000–8,000. Strict cancellation charges; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A teppanyaki restaurant in the basement of 紫光會館 on Pontocho (Tabelog). A June 2024 reviewer describes a hard-working master overseeing younger staff.

anecdotes.text: Visiting on a wedding anniversary in November 2025 without a booking, a couple went down on the strength of a flyer and were warmly welcomed.
A December 2025 year-end traveller who booked ahead tried yuba topped with caviar for the first time.
Two friends at the counter in July 2026 had a clear view of the grill on the ¥4,800 course.

Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats with sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog). kyoto_cafe_hypericum.notes: [Café · Okazaki near Heian Shrine, a quiet house café with a cat] A tiny café in an old house among greenery on Marutamachi, filled with antique furniture and a resident cat. Come for a bean spice curry lunch with pickles, or ohagi with a matcha latte, after the Kyocera Museum or Heian Shrine. Short hours: afternoons only, closed Monday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a calm traditional house with antique furniture, greenery, a goods corner and a cat.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 visitor dropped in for curry to take away and also bought the cat-shaped cookies.
A June 2025 diner nearly finished a whole jar of the pickled napa cabbage served with the curry.
A July 2026 guest walking from the Okura Bettei stopped for a 3 p.m. snack with no other customers there.

kyoto_yorozu_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. Asian set meals — kara-age, Sichuan boiled pork, mapo tofu, khao man gai, soup noodles — and cakes; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yorozu_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and pork mains; nam pla on the table (reviews).
kyoto_yorozu_shokudo.hours_raw: 11:30–20:30 Tuesday–Saturday; Sunday 11:30–14:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Set meals served through the day (September 2025; April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: tables at the front and back, and a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2025). On the Sanjo-kai shopping arcade, 397 m from Nijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yorozu_shokudo.notes: [Asian diner · Sanjo-kai arcade near Nijo, set meals all day] A stylish little diner-café on the covered Sanjo-kai arcade serving Asian-leaning set meals from lunch to evening: ethnic-spiced kara-age, Sichuan boiled pork, khao man gai, coriander-and-lime soup noodles, each with small sides and soup, plus a cake set for about ¥800. Quick and good value. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 June 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a small, deep shop on the Sanjo-kai arcade that works as café, diner and restaurant in one, with set meals into the evening.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner seasoned the kara-age set with the pickled chillies and nam pla on the table.
A March 2026 first-timer found a ¥800 cake set — apple pie and café au lait — rare these days.
A December 2025 visitor at an odd hour was looked after with great care.

kyoto_saredo_cafe_dining.gf_detail: Ask. Plate lunches with fried chicken and prawns, soup pasta, Chicago deep-dish pizza and crêpes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_saredo_cafe_dining.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, cheese pizza and cream crêpes (reviews).
kyoto_saredo_cafe_dining.hours_raw: 11:30–22:30 (last order 22:00), daily (Tabelog). Chicago pizza at dinner only (October 2026). Bookings recommended — lunch fills with reservations and queues form on the stairs before opening; a holiday lunch order took about 40 minutes (August–September 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 30 seats with counter and sofa seats; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome; steep stairs to the 2nd floor (Tabelog; September 2026). On the 2nd floor at Shichijo-Shinmachi, 5 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_saredo_cafe_dining.notes: [Café-dining · Shichijo-Shinmachi near Kyoto Station, plate lunches and Chicago pizza] A cosy second-floor café-dining room five minutes from Kyoto Station: vegetable-heavy plate lunches (shiba-zuke tartar chicken nanban is a favourite), chewy soup pasta and big griddle crêpes by day; Chicago deep-dish pizza and free-flow courses at night. Lunch fills with bookings — reserve. Open daily till 22:30.

roles: Operated by 有限会社アユム (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: The qualified-invoice holder is 有限会社アユム of Kita-ku, Kyoto (NTA). Our crawl also lists a sister café, きわみ saredoフレンチトーストかふぇ. Tabelog’s introduction: a café and dining spot five minutes from Kyoto Station with Chicago-style pizza, soup pasta and drinks for celebrations.
chef_bio.specialty: Shiba-zuke tartar chicken nanban plate; Chicago pizza.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 solo business traveller found a line on the stairs before opening even in the rain.
